scope: All 72 authored .tres module resources; all finite standalone geometry factories listed in extract_modules.gd, including 51 forest results/variants; every accepted Foundry phrase and itinerary in the pinned batch.
limits: Does not enumerate infinitely many seeded whole maps or their generated inline connectors.
Standalone module geometry does not include enemies/Bosses placed by a full-stage encounter consumer.
Godot data factories are evaluated; no gameplay/physics acceptance is inferred.
Proposed catalogue entries with no build implementation are not fabricated.
Historical alternatives and current candidates are categorized; library inclusion does not mean production admission.
